0.original: Managingway needs someone to retrieve a machine on the run.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

24.original: Search for the prototype supporter near Heimdall's Last Sight.

25.original: Deliver the prototype supporter to Managingway.

48.original: There's been an emergency call from Inventingway! One of his supporters under development has taken off without warning.

49.original: There's been an emergency call from Inventingway! Another one of his supporters has taken off without warning.

50.original: We tracked the machine as far as Heimdall's Last Sight, where deadly Allagan weapons are known to prowl.

51.original: As much as I dislike delegating dangerous tasks, we need you to find and retrieve the supporter. Please hurry...and be careful!

52.original: The supporter has ceased to function. Managingway will be eager to have it back.

53.original: Ah, you're back, and none the worse for the wear, thank goodness. You were able to retrieve our runaway supporter, I hope?

54.original: We're in your debt! Lest you wonder, this machine was designed to serve as our playmate.

55.original: In taking off as it did, it appears to have mistakenly identified the Allagan weapons as friends.

56.original: We're in your debt─again. It appears the machine still mistakenly identifies the Allagan weapons as friends...

57.original: We all need dreams, and it's a fine thing that Inventingway is dedicated to realizing his. I just wish he didn't create work for others in the process. It rather defeats the purpose of coming up with inventions to make our lives easier.
